title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
description: Rise up! The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles get an all-new look, new weapons, and awesome new powers! Join the legendary heroes, Raph, Leo, Donnie and Mikey as these brothers discover a Hidden City beneath New York, learn amazing mystic ninja skills, battle absurd mutants… and always find time for a slice of their favorite pizza! Cowabunga!

episodes.title: S1-E31Warren & Hypno, Sitting in a Tree
S1-E34How to Make Enemies and Bend People to Your Will
S1-E39Turtle-dega Nights: The Ballad of Rat Man
S1-E40The Ancient Art of Ninja Hide and Seek

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x1
episodes_data.description: The Turtles discover for the first time that they are not the weirdest things in New York when they encounter two villains from the Hidden City pursing a cat-like agent. They have their first encounter with Baron Draxum who is making mutants with the help of his Oozesquitos.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x2
episodes_data.description: Donnie creates new gear for his brothers in order for them to overcome their bad habits. However, the gear only becomes a nuisance as they fight mutated chef dubbed Meat Sweats, who plans to cook the turtles in order to gain their powers.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x3
episodes_data.description: In order to save April's job as a party captain at Albearto's Pizzeria, Donnie upgrades the main animatronic of Albearto, only for it to go out of control.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x4
episodes_data.description: Splinter has come down with the rat flu, and the Turtles must deal with its 7 different stages involving fever, "Wild Rat Man", "Captain Cuddle Cakes", "Ninja Supreme", karaoke love songs, and fan fiction. The Turtles hope that Splinter will make to the final stage called "Must Say Yes" so that they can ask him for whatever they want.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x5
episodes_data.description: Leo unseats Raph's wrestling idol Ghostbear from his title as the champion of the world after accidentally falling on him from the rafters. Raph soon becomes irked by Leo's cockiness and decides to wrestle him himself. When Ghostbear joins the fight, Raph learns that Ghostbear doesn't play by the rules.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x6
episodes_data.description: Mikey and Donnie try to get a Jupiter Jim moon buggy vehicle from a repo yard, where they run afoul of its owner Repo Mantis. In exchange for the prop vehicle, Mikey and Donnie are hired as repo men and are sent to repossess an RV on Long Island. However, the deal deteriorates when they meet the RV's possessor, a kind mutant named Todd Capybara, and his puppies.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x7
episodes_data.description: When Donnie's newly-built Turtle Tank goes missing, he and the Turtles must find it. While going after some usual suspects, they are unaware that the Turtle Tank was taken by Splinter, who is additionally invited to "dinner" with Meat Sweats.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x8
episodes_data.description: Longing for the excitements of hero life, Leo talks the team into tracking down the paper thief duo currently stalking the city. In doing so, the Turtles run into the Foot Clan, who use their mystic ability to create origami warriors from the stolen paper.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x9
episodes_data.description: While looking for gifts for Splinter, the Turtles traverse through Times Square where they fight the thuggish mascots lurking there.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x10
episodes_data.description: To prove himself as the greatest enemy of the Turtles, former news anchor-turned-mutant earthworm Warren Stone gets in the way of the Turtles as they track down Hypno-Potamus, who is abducting the animal partners of other magicians.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x11
episodes_data.description: After the Turtles stumble across a pizza restaurant in the mystical Undercity while following a Fire Yōkai, Leonardo drags his brothers into a pizza-shaped Maze of Death to obtain the ultimate prize....a free helping to the titular parlor's "world's greatest pizza". But in order to claim it, they will have to contend with the pizza's guardian in the form of the Minotaur who is the maze's assistant manager.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x12
episodes_data.description: The Turtles have a hard time watching their skateboarding idol Sydney Allen on the "Extreme Skateboarding Finals" and stopping a burglary at Gilbert's Department Store conducted by the Foot Clan at the same time.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x13
episodes_data.description: Leo, Mikey and April investigate a mysterious specter haunting a themed supermarket called Stock 'n Shop, which leads to their encounter with Baxter Stockboy.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x14
episodes_data.description: April and the brothers make Raph face his greatest fear: an adorable kids' TV show rabbit named Mrs. Cuddles. However, things aren't so funny anymore when Mrs. Cuddles suddenly comes to life and begins hunting the Turtle family to feed on their fears.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x15
episodes_data.description: Hypno-Potamus returns and causes havoc at April's homecoming dance by hypnotizing the attendees.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x16
episodes_data.description: After an unfortunate glue accident, the Turtles have to fight a whole host of villains like the Mutant Silverfish, the Foot Clan, Hypno-Potamus, and Warren Stone while literally being stuck together.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x17
episodes_data.description: The Turtles look for a way to eliminate New York City's Oozesquito problem.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x18
episodes_data.description: The Turtles plan their first public musical gig at Albearto Land. When it happens, it gets crashed by Albearto and his army of animatronic bears from failed Albearto's fastfood franchises.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x19
episodes_data.description: The Turtles end up facing a new and dangerous threat in their beloved city as Baron Draxum, Huginn, and Muninn gather some of their toughest mutant enemies like Meat Sweats, Hypno-Potamus, Warren Stone, Repo Mantis, and the Sando Brothers in a plot to destroy them.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x20
episodes_data.description: During a visit in April's school, Donatello becomes enamored with an exclusive tech club, the Purple Dragons, and joins them on the spot. However, when the Dragons abuse his tech for criminal purposes, Donatello is forced to choose between stopping the crooks and losing his treasured purple membership jacket.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x21
episodes_data.description: DIGG, a trio of unsuccessful girl musicians mutated into burrowing animals, begin sinking the Turtles' favorite pizza places into the ground, prompting the Turtles to go after them before they have no place left to get their favorite food.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x22
episodes_data.description: To ease their household chores, Donatello invents a new artificial intelligence, S.H.E.L.L.D.O.N., who begins to see exclusively to his creator's needs. Disgruntled, Raphael, Michelangelo and Leonardo choose to rewire the robot, which leads to near-fatal consequences for their brother.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x23
episodes_data.description:
Mikey goes on a solo mission to retrieve a classic video game based on Lou Jitsu's film Hot Soup. Incidentally, however, he will have to contend with the Foot Clan's new recruit who is on a very similar mission at the very same auction house.

Note: Ice Cream Kitty from the previous series makes a cameo as a statue.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x24
episodes_data.description: The simple task of returning a single DVD just before its loan period runs out is complicated by endless craziness in New York, including an encounter with Ghostbear.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x25
episodes_data.description: Things go sour when the Turtles try to help a down-and-out mutant in the form of the bellhop-turned-mutant bull from "Bug Busters" while at the same time planning a raid to obtain more of Big Mama's web goo. Bullhop eagerly decides to help his benefactors out.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x26
episodes_data.description: Frustrated by his brothers' childishness during an important mission, Donatello enhances their intelligence. However, things get quickly out of hand when they begin displaying Donatello's personality traits as well.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x27
episodes_data.description: When Michelangelo and Todd Capybara spy on Meat Sweats in order to learn his most delicious recipe, the Turtle and the mutant chef become BFFs after Meat Sweats accidentally absorbs Todd's niceness. The two of them go on a look for the extremely rare lunar truffle that only grows when the Moon is in alignment with Jupiter, and face its Were-Tree guardian.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x28
episodes_data.description: Leo loses his brothers in a portal and must venture to the mystic Hidden City to save them. He finds that they are on the pirate ship run by Capitán Piel.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x29
episodes_data.description: Raph becomes friends with a new sparring partner in the form of Frankenfoot and must keep it secret from his brothers, who don't like the guy. When Frankenfoot is driven from the lair, this gives the Foot Lieutenant and the Foot Recruit the opportunity to take it into the Foot Clan.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x30
episodes_data.description: As the Turtles try to find pieces of a strange metal Baron Draxum is looking for, Splinter intents to get to the bottom of odd goings-on at April's new job at the Foot Shack. He soon learns that the Foot plan to resurrect their ancient master the Shredder by reassembling the Kuroi Yoroi armor. As the parties clash, the secrets of Splinter's past finally come to light.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x31
episodes_data.description: Baron Draxum, Huginn, and Muninn want the gauntlet that Warren Stone has since it's part of the Kuroi Yoroi armor, but he's not giving it up without a fight and a side of betrayal. As the Turtles get involved with Warren's roommate Hypno-Potamus being threatened, April remembers who Warren Stone is as she was part of a fan club dedidicated to him called the Stoneheads.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x32
episodes_data.description: Leo and Donnie try desperately to help April enjoy a quiet day with a new friend named Sunita. They learn that she is a slime Yōkai who uses a special amulet to turn into a human. They soon get targeted by the Foot Clan since the boots that Sunita's human form is wearing are part of the Kuroi Yoroi.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x33
episodes_data.description: Señor Hueso has just remembered that an ogre gang called the Makers of Brutality and a reptilian gang called the Makers of Barbarianism have book reservations at Run of the Mill Pizza. While helping Señor Hueso at Run of the Mill Pizza since his employees have fled, Leo and Mikey get sidetracked by brotherly competition. They must overcome this to keep the peace while trying not to wreck Run of the Mill Pizza.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x34
episodes_data.description: Baron Draxum struggles to move up the ladder in the Foot Clan while Foot Recruit was displeased that she hasn't gotten her mark yet. Upon finding a loophole where a Foot Clan member who can outdo an acting leader can assume this position, Baron Draxum leads the Foot Recruit into organizing a blunder for the Foot Lieutenant and the Foot Brute when the next Kuroi Yoroi fragment is at the botanical gardens. Meanwhile, the Turtles hold a contest to see who can withstand the smell of the corpse flower at the same botanical gardens.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x35
episodes_data.description: The Turtles plumb the depths of a mysterious hidden library in search of a way to rescue Mayhem from April's mirror. While trying to be quiet, they must also evade not having a sound heard by the Bat Librarian's Hush-Bats and contend with the Foot Lieutenant and Foot Brute.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x36
episodes_data.description: When a competitive new video game sweeps New York, Donnie will do anything to reach rank No. 1. Though Donnie is unaware that the video game was created by the Purple Dragons.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x37
episodes_data.description: The Turtles lazy river ride through the sewers turns savage when Raph's separated and left alone.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x38
episodes_data.description: The Turtles' failed attempts to do good deeds turn all of New York against them.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x39
episodes_data.description: Splinter enters the Turtle Tank in a demolition derby.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x40
episodes_data.description: Splinter teaches his sons the Art of Ninja Concealment.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x41
episodes_data.description: The Turtles try to recover a piece of the Dark Armor from Repo Mantis' scrap yard.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x42
episodes_data.description: A ferocious mutant tries to ruin April and the Turtles fun day in the snow.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x43
episodes_data.description: April and Sunita search New York for Sunita's stolen cloaking brooch.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x44
episodes_data.description: The Turtles meet their favorite sci-fi movie star, Jupiter Jim.

episodes_data.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x45
episodes_data.description: With the dark armor nearly complete, the Turtles decide to get serious and embrace their ninja heritage.
